verdict.rationale: Raygun exposes an external access token and APIs (Deployments API, source-map/dSYM/ProGuard uploads) that are typically invoked from CI pipelines rather than a UI, implying some headless/automatable capability, and an official MCP server exists for programmatic access. However there is no explicit CLI, documented CI recipe, or statement that the whole product can be operated headlessly for automation. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless CLI tooling, documented pipeline examples, confirmation that all core workflows (not just uploads/deploy tracking) can run without the dashboard UI.
